followups.title: Integrate Achievement Persistence with SaveManager
followups.rationale: Wire the AchievementPersistence stub to the project's SaveManager; support storing unlocked achievements and persistent progress. Implement migrations and add save/load tests.

followups.title: Author Sample Achievement Assets
followups.rationale: Use the importer tool to create the 5 sample achievements (tutorial, first win, deck collector, combo master, long run) and commit them as designer-facing assets.

followups.title: Expand AchievementEvaluator and Add Coverage
followups.rationale: Subscribe to the game's event bus, implement composite criteria evaluation, and add deterministic unit and integration tests for evaluation logic.

followups.title: Editor Importer & Validation Window
followups.rationale: Enhance the importer to import JSON batch files, validate them against `Assets/docs/schemas/achievement.schema.json`, and provide preview and error reporting.

followups.title: CI Hooks for Achievements
followups.rationale: Add CI steps to validate achievement JSON against schema and run Editor tests for smoke-checks in CI.
